AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

2. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

5. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

9. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.

10. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.

11. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

12. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

13. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.

14. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
